name: OpenTender
description: Bid/no-bid on a public tender, before anyone writes a word of the bid. Upload the pack, load the jurisdiction's standard selection questions as a checklist, and let your agent read the documents against what your company can actually evidence. Every answer must carry a quote the app can find in the source, so a requirement is only cleared on evidence you can click through to. You get a verdict with the one requirement that decided it, the deadlines that are still open, and an honest list of what nobody has settled yet.

deploy.title: Deploy your OpenTender
deploy.subtitle: Know whether you can bid, on evidence, before the deadline decides for you.
